rules.rule: Grade lower than 28/35 not normally used unless specific durability requirement.

rules.rule: Cover: large foundations/pile caps/pads/wall footings 75; bottom of piled foundations 100 (mat rests on piles); earth face 45+dcdev; external exposed 35+dcdev; internal max(25, dia)+dcdev (tops of ground slabs, inside trenches).

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: As,min = max(0.26 bt d fctm/fyk, 0.0013 bt d). For 28/35 and fyk 500: 0.0014 bt d (also applies to nominal steel). Bar dia < 16 not used except lacers.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Min spacing 75 (>=40 dia: 100); pairs 100; max spacing 200 (as printed).

rules.rule: Lap for nominal bars >= max(15 dia, 200 mm).

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Column starters: min horizontal leg 450 mm unless column lightly loaded and design compressive stress < 50% of max bar capacity.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Pad footings / column strips: straight bars, no curtailment; anchorage length measured from face of wall/column to bar end; bob (bend) ends if anchorage length not available.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Banding: if lx > 1.5(cx+3d), >= 2/3 of reinforcement parallel to ly concentrated in a band of width (cx+3d) centred on the column; same transversely with x/y swapped.

logic.then: band_width = cx+3*d; band_fraction >= 2/3 for bars parallel to ly

rules.rule: Pile caps: full tension anchorage from centre line of the edge pile to end of bar.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Table 6.10 standard pile-cap layouts (2,3,4,5?,6,7 piles): design bars H20/H25/H32/H40 (easy bends); nominal H16 (H16/H20/H25 for 2-pile); shape codes 21, 12, 27, 25, 15; shape 99 where large mandrel needed.

rules.rule: Ground slabs (light): A193 square mesh; laps >= 300; cover 25 (40 if exposed).

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Ground beams: as 6.3 but cover 75 mm where no formwork. If beam spans onto pads/pile caps without top steel, continue main beam bars across foundation. As tie between foundations, main bars pass round column/wall starters and are fully anchored.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Rafts: designer gives instructions (construction joint positions for laps, movement joint position/width/depth, waterbar joints) confirmed with contractor; consider splice bars at laps in a separate layer to avoid congestion.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Ducts/trenches in ground slabs without design steel: nominal steel around them (Fig 6.31). In rafts/multi-column foundations keep top steel continuity across trenches where moment transfer needed (Fig 6.32). Small trench/manhole walls: single layer each direction.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Column/wall starters specified with footing steel. Consider chairs (BS 7973) and edge U-bars for top steel in multi-column bases/rafts.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: MF1 pad: kicker 75 (150 below ground); starters compression lap + 150; starters 450 min leg; column links H10-300 (3 No. min) unless specified; 75 cover; cover to starters from column faces; main bars normally straight, bobbed if design requires.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: MF2 pile cap: main bars bent both ends; bars rest on piles; 100 bottom cover; 2 layers of lacers H12; bob length by design; corner bar shifted if large bend radius.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: MF3 multi-column base: cover 40 exposed/50 buried; distribution bars H16@300; two layers of lacers H12; 300 min overlap; 75.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: MF4 ground slab and beam: mesh A193; extension to link not required if link width >= 300; 40/50 cover; 75.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: MF5 trenches: Detail A wall <=150, Detail B wall >150; tension lap = 1.4 x anchorage length; splay bars when design moment specified; 25 internal, 40 external; 50.
